turns.assessment: The outage is a multi-service digital-layer failure centered on S24. Multiple independent 400G line interfaces at S03 and S07 simultaneously report OTU_LOF, while received power, OSNR, BER-related optical telemetry, amplifiers, and channel monitors show no change. That rules strongly against fibre, amplifier, connector, WSS, and individual transceiver faults; the fan-out of affected channels from S24 is characteristic of an S24 OTN switch-fabric failure.

proposals.rationale: A switch-fabric failure at S24 can interrupt all ODUs cross-connected there across several outgoing lightpaths while leaving optical carrier power and OSNR unchanged. It explains the simultaneous OTU_LOF at multiple receivers at S03 and S07, all affected services using the S03-S24 segment, and SNCP services switching away from their working paths.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: S03 is also common to the principal affected routes and an OTN switch failure there could cause broad digital interruption, but it does not explain the additional OTU_LOF at S07 as directly as a failure at the S24 fan-out point.
